task_card.title: Gated models: license-verified install for non-commercial weights (Klein 9B first)

next_action.description: Implement the gate starting at js/data/modelConstants/licences.js - add the `verify: {repoId, probePath}` block to the LicenceDescriptor typedef and the FLUX.2 Klein 9B descriptor beside MINIMAX_H3. Read tasks/MPI-357/plan.md first; it carries the measured probe behaviour that the card's own acceptance criteria get wrong.

key_decisions: PROBE A WEIGHT FILE, NEVER LICENSE.md. Measured unauthenticated 2026-08-21: /api/models/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9B returns 200 (public metadata, gated:'auto') and resolve/main/LICENSE.md returns 200 with 18158 bytes, while resolve/main/flux-2-klein-9b.safetensors returns 401 with header X-Error-Code: GatedRepo. The card's acceptance criterion 4 ('probe of the gated repo returns 200 vs 403') therefore passes EVERY user and makes the gate decorative.

The HF token is never persisted. Probe once, keep only the existing receipt (verified + timestamp), re-ask on a later 403. Answers the card's open question 'where does the token live' with 'nowhere' - no safeStorage, no IPC, no credential at rest.

downloadService.start() needs no change: it already routes a gated model through showLicenceGate and only calls _start when that resolves true. Making the probe a precondition of that true leaves the R2 delivery, the Pod path and the receipts untouched.
Klein 9B's ModelDef is OUT of scope (Fabio, 2026-08-21). The other session benches 4B, not 9B. Ship the gate; 9B is the descriptor it is written against, not a model we install.
constraints: js/components/types.js (MpiLicenceGateProps, line ~1830) is held by a LIVE MPI-454 file claim. If the gate's props change, file an mpi-message - do not edit it. guard-claim will block the write anyway.

Half of this card already shipped as MPI-451: the descriptor map, MpiLicenceGate, the receipts in js/core/storage.js and the downloadService gate all exist and are wired for two MiniMax H3 ids. Do not rebuild any of it. licences/minimax-h3/ is the precedent for bundling a licence copy.

FLUX NCL v2.1, read against the real text 2026-07-26 (see brief.md): Outputs ARE commercially usable, and redistribution IS permitted under section 3 on conditions (pass the licence on, display the Attribution Notice). The licence relationship is user-to-BFL via their own HF account; Vision is a distributor under section 3, not a sublicensor. Do not re-litigate this as 'non-commercial means we cannot ship it'.

Unknown until someone has a real HF token: valid-token-but-terms-not-accepted (expect 403) vs bad/revoked token (expect 401). Both are handled in code from the start; only the user-facing copy depends on which is which. Does not block the build.

resume_prompt: Continue MPI-357 - 'Gated models: licence-verified install for non-commercial weights (Klein 9B first)', under umbrella MPI-528, currently in `doing` on master. Read .agents/mpi-kanban/state/handoffs/25ab343c-460c-4e98-9608-78fd57b7cfdf.json and .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-357/plan.md before touching anything. Half the card already shipped as MPI-451 (descriptor map, MpiLicenceGate, receipts, install gate - all live for two MiniMax H3 ids); what remains is the PROOF step that binds a user to the FLUX Non-Commercial Licence at Hugging Face before our own R2 hands them the weights.
